# Summary by contig
```{r}
calculate_overall_depth <-  function(depth_file_path){
  isolate = depth_file_path %>% basename() %>% gsub("_summary","",.)
  depth_file <- read_csv(depth_file_path)
  depth_file$contig <- depth_file$Locus %>% str_split(.,":",simplify=T) %>% .[,1]
  loci <- unique(depth_file$contig )
  locus_coverage <- lapply(loci,get_coverage_contig_level,depth_data=depth_file) %>% do.call(rbind,.)
  locus_coverage$isolate <- isolate
  return(locus_coverage)
  
}

get_coverage_contig_level <- function(locus,depth_data){
  depth_contig <- subset(depth_data,contig == locus)
  # Summary statistics
  mean <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth) / nrow(depth_contig)
  median <- median(depth_contig$Total_Depth)  
  non_zero <- subset(depth_contig$Total_Depth, depth_contig$Total_Depth > 0)
  mean_non_zero <-  sum(non_zero) / length(non_zero)
  median_non_zero <- median(non_zero)  
  # Breadth statistics
  loci_length <- nrow(depth_contig)
  n_nonzero_positions <- sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >0)
  percent_coverage_1 <- n_nonzero_positions / loci_length * 100
  percent_coverage_5 <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >=5) / loci_length * 100
  percent_coverage_10 <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >=10) / loci_length * 100
  percent_coverage_15 <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >=15) / loci_length * 100
  percent_coverage_20 <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >=20) / loci_length * 100
  percent_coverage_25 <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >=25) / loci_length * 100
  percent_coverage_50 <-  sum(depth_contig$Total_Depth >=50) / loci_length * 100
  
  results <- cbind.data.frame(locus,mean,median,mean_non_zero,median_non_zero,
                              loci_length,n_nonzero_positions,
                              percent_coverage_1,percent_coverage_5,percent_coverage_10,percent_coverage_15,percent_coverage_20,percent_coverage_25,percent_coverage_50)
  return(results)
}

coverage_statistics <- pbmcapply::pbmclapply(files_of_interest,calculate_overall_depth,mc.cores=12) %>%  do.call(rbind,.)

saveRDS(coverage_statistics,"./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/PathogenWatch_coverage_master_summary_file.RDS") 
```
